evidence.activity: Employees volunteer in their local communities, with total hours disclosed
evidence.quote: DaVita teammates volunteered over 70,000 hours throughout the year in service of their communities.

community.criterion: level 2: specific current volunteering with a figure, but no named program, partners or beneficiaries, so reach is limited

evidence.activity: DaVita Ladders career-development program, including Clinical Ladders, plus leadership development tools for field leaders
evidence.quote: This past year, we deployed these tools to over 10,000 additional teammates to enhance their opportunities for growth and mobility.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human capital management > Talent Pipeline and Career Development
evidence.indicators: over 10,000 additional teammates; more than 2,000 field leaders

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Scholarships for employees' children and grandchildren
evidence.quote: We also offer a number of scholarships for teammates' children and grandchildren.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human capital management > Total Rewards Program

community.criterion: level 2: specific current scholarship program for people outside the company, no figures disclosed

evidence.activity: Resources and leader training to build belonging and reduce bias in hiring and talent reviews
evidence.quote: We offer a suite of resources to help our leaders cultivate belonging on their teams, and reduce bias in hiring and talent reviews.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human capital management > Connection & Belonging

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current inclusion practice with no reach figures

evidence.activity: Annual company-wide Week of Belonging with activities and education for employees
evidence.quote: Each year we celebrate a Spirit Week and a Week of Belonging, engaging teammates globally with activities and education designed to further strengthen our culture.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human capital management > Connection & Belonging

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current inclusion program with no participation figures

evidence.activity: Disclosure of U.S. workforce gender and race/ethnicity composition
evidence.quote: As of December 31, 2025, DaVita in the U.S. was composed of 78% women and 59% people of color.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human capital management > Connection & Belonging

cross_cultural.criterion: level 1: workforce demographics are a disclosure, not an activity

evidence.activity: Corporate venture group that invests in and acquires kidney-care companies for strategic purposes
evidence.quote: DaVita Venture Group (DVG) focuses on innovative products, solutions and businesses that improve care for patients with kidney disease and related conditions.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Ancillary services, including our international operations > U.S. Other Ancillary services

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: strategic corporate venture, acquisition and partnership activity serving the company's own innovation, not a program aimed at founders' barriers

creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers kidney care and dialysis services in detail and shows no creative work created, enabled or used.

community.reason: Level 2: large employee development (E2) plus limited external activity (an aggregate volunteering-hours figure and unquantified scholarships), with no named program or reach indicators that clearly reach level 3, so the lower level applies when torn.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current internal inclusion practices (bias-reduction resources, annual Week of Belonging) with no reach or participation figures; demographics (E6) count only as disclosure.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the only related activity is the company's own strategic venture and innovation investing, with no specific program enabling founders or small businesses.

ai.notes: Items considered and not counted: (1) Patient and caregiver training for home dialysis is part of the core clinical service, not external education. (2) Mandatory annual compliance and safety training is compliance training. (3) Physician joint ventures fall under the 'joint venture' trap. (4) Operations in 14 countries are international operations only. (5) Statements about caring for patients 'regardless of location, insurance status' and commitments to equal pay are mission or commitment language. (6) The 85% belonging survey result is an outcome measure, not a program-reach figure, so it was not used as an indicator. (7) The Item 1 mention of an Executive Order on DEI programs is regulatory risk context, not company activity. (8) The DaVita Medical Group business is a past (discontinued) operation and is not relevant to any theme. (9) The Item 7 excerpts mention immigration and charitable organizations only as risk factors and market participants, not as company activities. (10) Volunteering (over 70,000 hours) was close to Community level 3 but lacks a named program, partners or beneficiary counts, so the lower level was chosen. Family-planning benefits (fertility, adoption, surrogacy) were not counted as an inclusion practice because the filing presents them as general family benefits.
